title: COOL (Cold Water for Exercise Recovery in Depression)
summary: The aim of the study is to investigate recovery after physical exertion in patients with a depressive disorder.

interventions.name: For this study, inpatient and outpatients with a depressive disorder will be recruited who have been stably adjusted to their medication for at least one week. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Sufficient German language proficiency
Ability to provide informed consent
Voluntary treatment
Diagnosis of a depressive episode
Stable maintenance medication for at least one week
No contraindication to physical exercise
No contraindication to cold exposure
Exclusion criteria:
Age < 18 years or > 65 years
Insufficient German language proficiency
Inability to provide informed consent
Involuntary treatment status
Contraindication to physical exercise
Pregnancy or suspected pregnancy
Existing severe cardiovascular disease requiring ongoing treatment (e.g., poorly controlled hypertension, heart failure, arrhythmias)
Cold-induced conditions (e.g., Raynaud’s syndrome, cold urticaria)
Acute infections
